davidSoundHealing.title: Sound Healing
davidSoundHealing.description: Sound Healing is an audio experience of guided imageries, music, mantra, and nature sounds created to ground the listener. What you will hear is a collection of pieces that take on new context in the various spaces you hear them. These pieces can be experienced in your personal practice of meditation, relaxation, massage, rest, prayer and reflection.
